notes: The 400 and 600 drawings are newly authored local variants of the edited Turnpike source, rather than the upstream weight instances.

A shared whole-ink deformation field uses regularization 0.005, blur 18, and endpoint amounts ±14. Every cubic is split exactly at the common 48-unit triangle boundaries before the affine maps are applied.

The complete map has positive endpoint and intermediate triangle Jacobians. It preserves component contacts and counters throughout interpolation. Y extent and left ink edge remain fixed; advance follows the change in ink width.

Slash, backslash, X, closing parenthesis and y handles are clamped to their endpoint rectangles in the neutral drawing. Corrections of at most seven units remove pre-existing microscopic crossing islands at their caps. Original outline-v1 data stays unchanged.
Local width recipe Turnpike: a smooth horizontal ink/space field, compiled to compatible Bézier drawings. These are new TypeLab designs, not upstream width instances.
Shared exact cuts retain the neutral family; every new segment records its old segment and parameter interval in a separate master-subdivision-v1 binding. Maximum sampled fit error 0.015 font units.

Rigid glyph constructions iIl!¡|.,:;'"‘’“”„‚·•` retain their ink shape and gain centered spacing. Dots on ij?:;¿… translate without distortion. Other glyphs preserve vertical coordinates and distribute width through horizontal white space.

The 400 and 600 drawings are smoothed: every point of the 500 drawing moves by the same ink field (blur 18; amounts -11.553 and 11.652, matched to the ink of HOnoaesd in the drawings they replace) read at the point itself, its handles by the field's linear map there, instead of by a 48-unit triangle mesh. Straight edges stay straight and short corners between them move whole to where the new edges meet. Points, contours and handles match the 500 drawing one for one. Letters the mesh did not make keep their drawings (tools/masters/smooth-masters.ts).
